title: Open-Meteo historical archive – Berlin grid point, 20–28 September 2026
claims: For the grid point 52.5200 N / 13.4050 E over 20–28 September 2026, daily maximum temperature ranged from 15.3 C to 24.6 C with a median of 19.2 C.
Daily minimum temperature ranged from 6.3 C to 13.0 C with a median of 11.2 C.
Four of the nine days recorded at least 1 mm of precipitation and none recorded at least 5 mm.
On 27 September 2026 the grid point recorded a maximum of 22.9 C, a minimum of 12.0 C and 0.0 mm precipitation.
These values are modelled reanalysis data for a grid point, not measurements taken on the course.
